_format: buildings: { <feature uid (or pf_uid / id — the UID the info panel shows)>: { name, sources[], notes, set: {props merged onto the feature}, phases: [ {props merged over the original feature} ] } }. `set` is for plain corrections (e.g. a born date). Each phase becomes its own feature with the same footprint. base_floors = the storey the phase's volume starts at. born/died are completion/removal dates; construction_months overrides the size-based build time; died_by: 'fire' shows it burning. date_precision records how exact the dates are ('year' = mid-year placeholder). wall_color (in set or a phase) fixes the wall colour: a name from CONFIG.palettes.named (darkRed, red, orangeRed, buff, cream, tyndall, sandstone, grey) or a hex string like '#A0452E'. Survives merge_assessment.py regenerating the GeoJSON. wall_stripes adds stone/brick bands over the wall colour: a colour alone (one band per storey on the floor lines), or {color, every, height, offset, base} in metres (base = solid course at the bottom). roof_type 'dome', 'bell' (ogee) or 'conical' gives a curved tower roof; roof_height (m) and roof_color (named colour incl. slate/copper/newCopper, or hex) are optional.

76e52ce7-2b91-4411-ad15-e526e36f7087.name: Leland Hotel
76e52ce7-2b91-4411-ad15-e526e36f7087.notes: Built 1883–1884 (Barber & Barber). Four storeys added 1892 (to six; Goad 1906 shows 6.5). The added storeys were gutted by fire in 1913 and removed rather than rebuilt. The remaining lower building was destroyed by arson in January 1999. Exact months unknown except January 1999.
